readerCopy.summary: A quiet overhaul of everyday infrastructure shifts power without causing a panic.
readerCopy.body: A quiet overhaul of everyday infrastructure shifts power without causing a panic. Updates to financial systems, supply chains, or operational software give ordinary participants access to tools once guarded by gatekeepers. Uranus changes the working system, while Pluto restructures who holds authority inside it. Under the trine, reform and redistribution reinforce each other without requiring the system to collapse first. The change can take root with less friction because cost, deadlines, and existing responsibilities were considered from the beginning.
